# Category Decision Tree

Choose exactly one of the 10 categories when storing knowledge:

| Question | Category |
|---|---|
| Verified? (known to be true) | `fact` |
| Instruction? (how to do something) | `rule` |
| Non-existent? (proposal, not yet real) | `idea` |
| From an outcome? (observed result of an action) | `learning` |
| Generally accepted? (widely-known concept) | `concept` |
| Efficient method? (a faster/better way) | `trick` |
| Efficient thinking? (a mental shortcut) | `heuristic` |
| Validated incorrect pattern? (a known mistake) | `bias` |
| Past choice? (a decision made) | `decision` |
| A unit of work to do | `task` |
